sentences.en: The surgeon persuaded me to undergo an organ transplant operation.
sentences.zh: 外科医生说服我接受了器官移植手术。

sentences.en: Eventually the salesman persuaded me to buy the expensive machine.
sentences.zh: 最终，推销员说服我买了那台昂贵的机器。

sentences.en: The police persuaded her not to jump off the bridge.
sentences.zh: 警察劝说她不要从桥上跳下去。

senses.zh: 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事
